Please check Warranty Policy for more information. EDM FAQs Why does my 2TB G55 show only about 1.82TB in Windows? Answer: This is normal. SSD manufacturers use decimal units, so 2TB equals 2,000,000,000,000 bytes. Windows calculates capacity using binary units but typically labels the result as “TB.” This means a 2TB SSD appears as approximately 1.82TB in Windows—technically 1.82TiB, or 1,863GiB. The difference comes from how capacity is calculated, not missing storage. The space available for your files may be slightly lower after formatting and system partitions are created. Q2: What’s the real speed I can expect? Answer: Up to 10,300 MB/s read and 9,000 MB/s write  but only on a PCIe Gen5 x4 slot like Intel 14th Gen or AMD Ryzen 9000. On Gen4 slots goes max 7,000 MB/s. Check your motherboard! Q3: Can I use the G55 in my laptop? Answer: Yes! It fits any M.2 2280 slot PCIe 3.0/4.0/5.0. Super slim at 2.3mm thick perfect for thin gaming laptops. Just make sure your laptop supports NVMe SSDs. Q4: Does it get hot during gaming or video editing? Answer: It gets warm like any fast SSD, but uses 50% less power than other Gen5 drives thanks to its smart 7nm chip. No built in heatsink, but add one if your case is tight or you run 24/7 workloads.
